Biography & Credentials

About Me

Doctoral Researcher in Information Theory & Quantum Information · IMT Atlantique Cybersecurity Engineer · Freelance Security Consultant

Mustapha El Bouazaoui

I am a PhD researcher at UM6P College of Computing (Rabat, Morocco) working on Secrecy Capacity and Coding for Noisy Quantum Wiretap Channels, and a graduate of IMT Atlantique (France) holding a State Engineering Degree in Cybersecurity and Telecommunications.

My background bridges rigorous mathematical theory with hands-on security engineering. I actively consult as a freelance cybersecurity engineer specializing in penetration testing, attack surface management, and SIEM detection engineering, while advancing open scientific research in physical-layer and quantum security.

PhD Researcher in Information Theory & Quantum Information

UM6P — Mohammed VI Polytechnic University · College of Computing
Doctoral dissertation on "Secrecy Capacity and Coding for Noisy Quantum Wiretap Channels". Researching physical-layer security bounds, quantum private classical capacity, and code constructions (polar/LDPC) for secure communications over degraded and noisy quantum channels.
